decisions.label: Wave speed ×
decisions.note: How fast the ley pulse runs to the next stone, times the spark's speed by the tempo (leyLines.pulseSpeed; 1 as built: Ed, 2026-10-18, "let me set this from the pause menu"; since Ed, 2026-11-03, the speed itself rises in a straight line from 1.0 m/s at 100 bpm to 5.0 at 200, leyLines.pulseAt100/pulseAt200, the Difficulty sliders); a wave lands as it reaches its stone, so at 2 they come twice as often. 0 holds the pulse where it is: no waves. Live during a night, remembered on this browser; the boot keeps its own 4 m/s (boot.speed).
